records.title: Multimodal Large Language Models Meet Multimodal Emotion Recognition and Reasoning: A Survey
records.reason: Survey scope is emotion tasks, datasets, model architectures, and benchmarks; no inference-efficiency method is evaluated.

records.title: A Survey of Foundation Model-Powered Recommender Systems: From Feature-Based, Generative to Agentic Paradigms
records.reason: Full survey conclusion and taxonomy focus recommendation applications and research opportunities; it does not present a general LLM-serving optimization.

records.title: Tra-MoE: Learning Trajectory Prediction Model from Multiple Domains for Adaptive Policy Conditioning
records.reason: Methods/evaluation concern robot trajectories and policy conditioning; no LLM inference optimization.

records.title: LLAVADI: What Matters For Multimodal Large Language Models Distillation
records.reason: Experiments analyze distillation components and student quality; smaller model scale may help deployment, but the main contribution is training/distillation and no direct serving-cost benchmark establishes an efficiency intervention.

records.title: Generalizable, real-time neural decoding with hybrid state-space models
records.reason: Evaluation is neural-signal decoding rather than language-model inference or serving.
